answer: One concrete mechanism: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The network ties the timber to sunk effort, uses the inlet as an corroborating signal, then requires a pulse before any payout.
